cases.exposure_context_quote: A 38-year-old male, identified as a farmer, presented to the emergency department following a suicide attempt by ingestion of an unidentified toxic substance.
cases.agent: indoxacarb (non-organophosphorus oxadiazine insecticide); initially unidentified substance, later identified by family
cases.agent_quote: Upon further inquiry with the patient's family, they provided information regarding the ingested substance, which was identified as indoxacarb, a non-organophosphorus oxadiazine insecticide.
cases.circumstance: suicide attempt by ingestion; first treated at a nearby primary healthcare facility before ED presentation

symptoms.finding: cyanosis of tongue; hypoventilation; GCS 14/15; SpO2 83% on 4 L oxygen
symptoms.quote: his oxygen saturation was 83% while receiving four liters of supplemental oxygen.
the patient displayed signs of hypoventilation and exhibited evidence of tongue cyanosis, as depicted in Figure 1.

symptoms.finding: chocolate brown appearance of blood on arterial blood gas analysis
symptoms.quote: Notably, arterial blood gas analysis unveiled a distinct chocolate brown appearance of the patient's blood, as illustrated in Figure 2, indicative of possible methemoglobinemia.

cases.time_to_care: UNVERIFIED (presented after prior treatment at a nearby primary healthcare facility; no interval given)

labs.name: serum cholinesterase
labs.quote: serum cholinesterase level was 0.76 IU/L (within the normal range of 0.6-1.5 IU/L), indicative of nominal enzymatic activity.

labs.name: alanine aminotransferase
labs.quote: Liver function tests revealed mildly elevated levels of alanine aminotransferase (80 IU/L) and aspartate aminotransferase (106 IU/L)

labs.name: aspartate aminotransferase
labs.quote: Liver function tests revealed mildly elevated levels of alanine aminotransferase (80 IU/L) and aspartate aminotransferase (106 IU/L)

labs.name: total leukocyte count
labs.quote: The total leukocyte count measured 9600, within normal limits, while serum creatinine remained within the reference range.

labs.name: serum creatinine
labs.value: within the reference range (numeric value UNVERIFIED)
labs.quote: The total leukocyte count measured 9600, within normal limits, while serum creatinine remained within the reference range.

labs.name: urinalysis specific gravity / pH
labs.quote: Urinalysis demonstrated a specific gravity of 1.016 with a pH of 5.8, devoid of pus or red blood cells.

labs.name: serum methemoglobin level
labs.value: UNVERIFIED (test unavailable at facility: 'due to the unavailability of serum methemoglobin testing at our facility, definitive confirmation of the diagnosis was impossible')
labs.quote: However, due to the unavailability of serum methemoglobin testing at our facility, definitive confirmation of the diagnosis was impossible through conventional means.

treatment.name: atropine and gastric lavage (at primary healthcare facility)
treatment.quote: He had previously received treatment at a nearby primary healthcare facility, where he underwent atropine administration and gastric lavage.

treatment.name: oxygen (non-rebreather mask)
treatment.quote: Following oxygen analysis using a non-rebreather mask

treatment.name: intravenous methylene blue 1 mg/kg in 100 cc normal saline, then 60 mg twice daily
treatment.quote: intravenous methylene blue (1 mg/kg) was administered in 100 cc of normal saline ... Subsequently, the patient received intravenous methylene blue (60 mg) twice daily

treatment.name: intravenous vitamin C 1 gram, then 500 mg twice daily
treatment.quote: alongside intravenous vitamin C (1 gram) and dextrose-containing fluids. Subsequently, the patient received ... vitamin C (500 mg) intravenously twice daily.

treatment.name: dextrose-containing fluids
treatment.quote: alongside intravenous vitamin C (1 gram) and dextrose-containing fluids.

cases.outcome: gradual improvement; SpO2 92-95% day 2, 95-97% after tapering oxygen, 98% on 5 L/min by day 5
cases.outcome_quote: By day five, the patient demonstrated remarkable gas exchange while on an oxygen face mask, with oxygen saturation reaching 98% at five liters per minute.
cases.notes: Methemoglobinemia not laboratory-confirmed (MetHb assay unavailable); diagnosis clinical. Hospitalization duration beyond day 5 and formal outcome (discharge status) UNVERIFIED.
